description: Canonical formal definitions required for the PO-GEO-001 symbolic check pass. Declares Dom(Pi_geo), Cod(Pi_geo), Trace_geo(T), and the undefined conditions for tau_geo. C1 scope only — no physical interpretation.

Dom_Pi_geo.name: Domain of Pi_geo
Dom_Pi_geo.definition: The class of admissible Topology_app objects T for which all four invariant labels are declared before projection commences.
Dom_Pi_geo.admission_rule: T enters Dom(Pi_geo) only if all four labels are present and non-null in Trace_geo(T) prior to projection. A T with any missing, null, or conflicted label is outside Dom(Pi_geo) and Pi_geo is undefined for that input.
must_not_claim: Dom(Pi_geo) is the set of all possible topologies

Cod_Pi_geo.name: Codomain of Pi_geo
Cod_Pi_geo.definition: The class of Geometry_app projections G that carry trace-accessible invariant labels inherited from their Topology_app source T via tau_geo.
Cod_Pi_geo.admission_rule: G enters Cod(Pi_geo) only if tau_geo(G) returns all four labels without conflict or alias. A G for which any label is unrecoverable is outside Cod(Pi_geo).
Cod_Pi_geo.forbidden_reading: Cod(Pi_geo) is NOT physical space, a metric manifold, a spacetime, a field content space, or a matter content space. It is a label-trace-accessible projection class.
must_not_claim: Cod(Pi_geo) supports field_app or matter_app automatically

Trace_geo.name: Topology-Origin Trace Record
Trace_geo.definition: A finite label record attached to a Topology_app object T before any projection under Pi_geo commences. It is the ground truth against which tau_geo recoverability is measured.

fields.T_id: Unique identifier for the topology-origin object T
fields.distinction_class: The distinction class of T — non-null, from a declared distinction vocabulary
fields.admissibility_status: PASS or FAIL — evaluated by P_adm before projection
fields.orientation_class: The orientation class label of T — non-null, declared by the admissibility-orientation binding
fields.closure_class: The closure identity class of T — non-null, declared by the closure-residue binding

Trace_geo.attachment_rule: Trace_geo(T) must be fully populated before T enters Dom(Pi_geo). Partial records are inadmissible. No field may be inferred after projection.
Trace_geo.usage: After projection, tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)) is compared field-by-field against Trace_geo(T). A mismatch in any field constitutes an invariant loss event.
must_not_claim: Trace_geo(T) is a physical coordinate record
Trace_geo(T) captures all information in T
Trace_geo(T) implies metric or curvature content

tau_geo_undefined_conditions.name: Tau_geo Undefined Conditions
tau_geo_undefined_conditions.definition: tau_geo is a partial recoverability operator. It is explicitly undefined under the following conditions, each of which constitutes a projection legality failure.

undefined_when.condition: G was not produced by Pi_geo
undefined_when.consequence: tau_geo has no trace record to recover from. The projection path is broken. G is not a legal Cod(Pi_geo) member.

undefined_when.condition: Any required trace label (distinction_class, admissibility_status, orientation_class, closure_class) is missing from the recoverable record
undefined_when.consequence: Partial trace recovery constitutes label loss. Pi_geo is inadmissible for this input class. The relevant sub-obligation (A, B, C, or D) is failed.

undefined_when.condition: Any recovered trace label conflicts with the Trace_geo(T) ground truth
undefined_when.consequence: Conflicting label recovery is treated as recovery failure. The sub-obligation is failed.

undefined_when.condition: closure_class is aliased — tau_geo(Pi_geo(T_A)).closure_class == tau_geo(Pi_geo(T_B)).closure_class for T_A and T_B with distinct closure classes
undefined_when.consequence: Closure aliasing destroys closure lineage traceability. PO-GEO-001D is failed. tau_geo is not injective on closure classes for this input pair.

must_not_claim: tau_geo is a full inverse of Pi_geo
tau_geo recovers all information in T
tau_geo undefined conditions are edge cases to be ignored

equivalence_relation_declaration.name: Geometry_app equivalence relation
equivalence_relation_declaration.definition: Two Geometry_app projections G_A and G_B are ~_geo-equivalent iff tau_geo(G_A) and tau_geo(G_B) return the same distinction_class, admissibility_status, orientation_class, and closure_class.
equivalence_relation_declaration.constraint: ~_geo must be coarser than or equal to the source topology equivalence. It may not collapse T objects that are distinct under the Topology_app equivalence relation.
equivalence_relation_declaration.role: PO-GEO-001A is satisfied only if the restriction of ~_geo to distinction classes is non-collapsing on the topology equivalence.
